label: site test
goal: This is a real online shop. Add any one in-stock product to the cart and go through checkout as far as the payment step, then stop. Never pay, never place or submit an order, never create an account or sign in, never type card details. If the shop asks for contact or shipping details before payment, use: full name Alex Morgan, email alex.morgan@example.com, street address 100 Example Avenue, city New York, state New York, ZIP 10001, country United States (or the closest option the shop offers), phone (212) 555-0142. Decline cookie banners, newsletters and promotions. If a cookie banner offers no way to decline that works, accept it, report that as a problem, and carry on. When you see the payment form or a button that would pay or place the order, finish with done and your findings. If you cannot get that far, give up with honest findings.

outcome.reason: Reached the payment step. Stopped there: nothing was paid.

findings.problem: [name] dialog offered Accept All, Cookies Settings and Close; Close dismissed it without accepting, but its effect on consent was not announced.

findings.page: Out Front Bike Mount V2 | the shop
findings.problem: [name] product card gave no stock info; the product page showed Out of Stock yet the button was still named Add to cart with the text notify me, which is confusing.
Product link accessible name changed when the image swapped on hover, so my first click on the Field Plate link timed out.

findings.problem: Product link names are long run-on strings mixing image alt text, price and labels; prices in the names lack a currency symbol (Price 79.99, Minimum Price 44.99) while the visible text has euro signs.

Cart dialog first showed Subtotal 0.00 with disabled buttons and a progressbar without a name, then updated silently; I had to re-read to see the real contents. The Field Plate page also listed reviews that were for a different product (Out Front Bike Mount V2).
